explanation:
The central tree is reduced from 113 lines/8,960 characters to 69 lines/5,881 characters: 38.9% fewer lines and 34.4% fewer characters. Six peripherals give mechanisms a primary explanatory location: push resolution, workflow lifetime, capture provenance, change derivation/replay, review recovery, and record publication. M = modular structure, C = calls, O = ownership, D = data dependency. Nesting groups concepts; only explicit call sequences imply order.

Following the critique, the center emphasizes owners, inputs, transitions, and handoffs. Numeric limits, queue mechanics, classification rules, and recovery details live in peripherals. Peripherals sit beside their attachment regions. All seven trees are connected; edge endpoints and nonoverlapping text bounds were checked. Rendered connector routing remains unverified.

Evidence comes only from the point definition and six pinned source texts. Push details use pushIntegrationService.ts and gitPushSource.ts; workflow details use diffSessionWorkflowService.ts; capture, edits, and acceptance use changeSessionService.ts; record details use changeSessionRecords.ts and diagramChangeSession.ts. Source additions beyond the seed include endpoint comparison with empty commit lists, separate API receipt queues, four-preview batches, manifest-token contents, and hunk-context validation.

Corrections to the seed: existing push deliveries can replay before enablement checks; capture skips unrelated repository documents before snapshots and rejects a mismatch detected afterward; final proposal validation occurs after runAgentWorkflow returns, outside the agent-step callback; history/tree/migration edits can finish ready when the same update explicitly requests and passes readiness validation. The added-diagram rule requires the containing source diagram to exist in the baseline; its owner node may be new.

Point-level handoff references use the supplied relationships: canvas, agent-api, generation, and storage. I did not adopt the critique's suggestion to resolve local uncertainties using other canvases: those sources are outside the permitted evidence. No foreign diagram IDs or implementation guarantees are inferred. The workflow definition, DiffSessionTools internals, repository adapter, catalog publication, and immutable-record helpers are not pinned. Consequently, the diagrams establish observed calls and receipt recovery, not catalog atomicity or the imported workflow's exact scheduling.

Git Change Proposals
|-- [M] Push intake: PushIntegrationService coordinates source, workflow, and store
|   |-- Public connection and delivery APIs keep Git resolution behind PushSource
|   |-- [C] A decoded event identifies one generation by connectionId + eventId
|   |   |-- Matching delivery reuses pending or stored work; changed payload conflicts
|   |   `-- New generation requires both connection and application enablement
|   |-- Branch classification can end in skipped without creating a proposal
|   |   `-- Non-branch, deletion, unchanged endpoint, or equal endpoint trees
|   `-- [D] GitPushSource resolves pinned before/after into workflow inputs
|       |-- Registered checkout identity binds remote events to the local repository
|       |-- Reachability supplies commits; ancestry supplies kind; trees supply delta
|       `-- Net content change -> workflow.start with generation ID as requestId
|-- [M] Agent orchestration: DiffSessionWorkflowService produces a reviewable proposal
|   |-- Public start/get/cancel/dispose; proposal acceptance has a separate boundary
|   |-- Request selects baseline session OR repository context; replay must match
|   |-- [C] start -> begin -> background execute; capture precedes agent execution
|   |-- [O] Service owns pending starts, active abort controllers, and live run state
|   |   `-- Completion, failure, cancellation, and interruption remain distinct outcomes
|   |-- [D] Captured context and nonempty hunks are required workflow evidence
|   |   `-- Context, prompts, step outputs, conversation, and metrics become artifacts
|   |-- DiffSessionTools binds capture, proposal service, agent service, source reader
|   |   `-- Canvas tool handoff: related point agent-api; workflow runner: generation
|   `-- runAgentWorkflow returns -> service checks its own proposal is already ready
|       `-- Completed means ready for review; it does not mean accepted
|-- [M] Proposal workspace: ChangeSessionService separates originals from edits
|   |-- Exposes capture/create, snapshot/descriptor, apply/createDocument/update/request
|   |-- Depends on session repository, project/repository catalog, and CanvasSessionPort
|   |-- [D] Frozen capture supplies both analysis evidence and proposal starting state
|   |   |-- Repository context determines hunks; settled representations supply baselines
|   |   |-- Selected live snapshots replace matching saved baselines within that context
|   |   `-- A baseline-session request reuses originals and pinned hunks, not old edits
|   |-- [O] create clones captured documents into a draft; signature guards replay
|   |   |-- Existing documents retain baseline, saved revision expectation, and proposal
|   |   `-- New documents have no baseline; canonical history retains proposal undo/redo
|   `-- [M] Shared document controller edits isolated proposals: related point canvas
|       `-- Serialization, history reconstruction, and change derivation stay internal
|-- [D] Review changes are derived from baseline versus proposed document state
|   |-- Generated targets describe new canvases, variants, and changed/added diagrams
|   |-- [C] apply -> controller.applyUpdate -> record proposal/history -> refreshChanges
|   |   `-- Document versions guard edits; serialized mutations advance session version
|   |-- Annotations add explanations and dependencies without changing generated targets
|   |   `-- Stable change IDs retain matching annotations when changes are regenerated
|   |-- update exposes history, DiffTree, migrations, annotations, title, and status
|   |   `-- History/tree/migration edits set draft; explicit ready revalidates afterward
|   `-- Readiness validates a proposal's consistency before review acceptance
|       |-- Require changes; validate optional DiffTree, migrations, and repository ownership
|       `-- Check dependency graph and edge anchors; added diagrams need baseline linkage
|-- [M] Review and acceptance: ChangeSessionService hands publication to project catalog
|   |-- list/get/preview/readDiffTree/readTreemaps expose progressively scoped reads
|   |   `-- Captured hunks and proposal previews supply review without reading live Git
|   |-- [D] Treemaps require stored DiffTree and document previews at one checked version
|   |-- [C] accept(requestId, expectedVersion) serializes acceptance for this session
|   |   |-- Require expected version and ready status; revalidate before publication
|   |   |-- Generated change document IDs select which proposals will be published
|   |   `-- Matching live originals across project workspaces must still match baselines
|   |-- Catalog call carries proposed documents/history and saved revision expectations
|   |   `-- Publication handoff: related point storage; catalog internals are not pinned here
|   `-- [O] Catalog acceptance receipt governs accepted status and recovery
|       |-- Proposal edits stop after acceptance; retry must match request and proposal version
|       `-- Read projection and full-record repair recover a later session-write failure
`-- [M] Durable proposal records: ChangeSessionRecords behind the repository boundary
    |-- Public summaries, scoped preview/DiffTree, full read, and write serve distinct costs
    |-- Domain validation checks identity, acceptance consistency, context, and document state
    |-- [O] Format-2 manifest owns references to separately stored proposal records
    |   `-- Document states, histories, receipts, and DiffTree can be restored independently
    |-- [C] write serializes publication, checks an optional token, and reuses unchanged refs
    |   `-- Complete document references and matching DiffTree summary/data precede publishJson
    `-- [M] DiagramPersistence delegates revision storage: related point storage
        `-- Local source establishes call boundaries; imported publication helpers remain opaque

Push decisions from pinned endpoints
|-- [C] receive checks pending/stored work before enablement
|   |-- Compare entire decoded event; recheck pending after async reads
|   `-- Store createGeneration arbitrates an already stored identity
|-- [D] Git computes three independent answers
|   |-- rev-list --reverse --topo-order after ^before gives commits
|   |-- before ancestor of after: update; ancestry exit 1: force-push
|   `-- Compare endpoint trees; absent before means new branch + empty tree
|       `-- Empty commit list can still enter endpoint-comparison workflow
|-- [M] resolve hides checkout selection, credentials, and Git commands
|   |-- Missing configured credential fails; prompts and redirects disabled
|   |-- Check endpoint commits; fetch missing SHAs without writing FETCH_HEAD
|   `-- Reject shallow clone or more than 2000 discovered commits
`-- [O] pending entry lives until execution settles
    `-- get refreshes only running generations that have a workflowRunId

Workflow execution lifetime
|-- [O] starts holds begin promises; active holds abort controllers
|   |-- live holds mutable runs; callers receive clones
|   `-- Background execute finalizer removes active/live entries
|-- [C] start requires AI enabled before validating request and replay
|   `-- Hash requestId for run ID; stored request must match exactly
|-- [C] Runtime session receives tools selected by requested step
|   |-- Step stage is typed analyze/materialize; definition is imported
|   |-- Save request before runStep; save response and metrics afterward
|   `-- Tools callback saves the proposal ID onto the run
|-- [C] Validation compares returned proposal ID to tools.changeSessionId
|   `-- Ready status must already exist; service does not mark it ready
|-- [O] cancel signals abort; status changes when execute handles it
|   |-- Finally attempts artifacts, then session disposal and run save
|   `-- dispose aborts all active runs and disposes runtime
`-- [C] get reports running without local active/start entry as interrupted
    `-- This read neither persists that status nor restarts work

Capture provenance and isolation
|-- [D] Hunk capture distinguishes absent comparisonBase from explicit base
|   `-- No commits + undefined base -> []; explicit base allows capture
|-- [C] Live workspace selection is project-scoped
|   |-- Unknown canvasId rejects; multiple workspaces require canvasId
|   |-- Skip unrelated repository documents before requesting snapshots
|   `-- Repository mismatch after snapshot -> changed-context error
|-- [O] Snapshot capture imports returned revisions and clones state
|   `-- Retain snapshot name, saved revision ID, and captured version
|-- [D] baselineChangeSessionId supplies all repository/canvas inputs
|   |-- Reject simultaneous repository, commits, head, canvas, or base
|   `-- Keep only original baselines; require at least one original
|       `-- Clone pinned hunks; fork fresh histories; omit proposal-only docs
`-- [O] Creation receipt includes a capture hash for supplied captures
    `-- Session ID hashes projectId + requestId; mismatched signature rejects

Derived changes and mutation replay
|-- [D] refreshChanges classifies affected documents
|   |-- Null baseline -> type 3; review/selection differences -> type 1
|   |-- Grid diagram display OR incident edges differ -> diagram change
|   `-- Existing diagram -> type 1; newly present -> type 2
|       `-- Previous type 4 survives only a regenerated type 1
|-- [C] Annotation replacement covers every generated ID exactly once
|   `-- Document/node targets stay fixed; only type 1 <-> 4 can change
|-- [C] mutate reads request receipt before editability/version checks
|   |-- Matching signature replays; new edits reject accepted/archived state
|   `-- Persist changed-version documents, new receipt, and changed DiffTree
|-- [C] request uses a separate api:session queue for bound API mutations
|   |-- Execute before receipt write; store api:requestId under session queue
|   `-- Receipt-only write does not increment session version
`-- [O] Legacy undo states import into canonical history once
    `-- Preserve nodeOrigins; record clears legacy past/future arrays

Review consistency and acceptance recovery
|-- [D] Treemap previews load in batches of four
|   |-- Check each effective preview version, then final effective summary
|   `-- Concurrent update -> conflict; supplied matching version -> null
|-- [D] Explicit hunkIds override node-derived selection in readDiffTree
|   `-- Page hunks with optional patches; return unmapped node IDs
|-- [C] Ready dependency check uses DFS: unknown IDs and cycles reject
|   `-- It validates references; it does not execute prerequisites
|-- [C] Type-2 incoming edge must resolve its source in baseline scene
|   `-- Source owner may be new; containing diagram must already exist
|-- [C] Acceptance matches live document ID OR representation ID
|   `-- Compare document state + name only for documents with baselines
`-- [O] Receipt version must match the saved ready proposal version
    |-- list/preview project accepted status; get repairs the full record
    |-- finishAcceptance sets version = receipt.sessionVersion + 1
    `-- accept calls get first; retry uses original expectedVersion

Record ownership and publication checks
|-- [O] Manifest references document records and a receipt-reference map
|   |-- Document metadata, baseline, proposal, and history are split
|   `-- History header excludes snapshots; checkpoints have separate refs
|-- [C] Module-wide queue keys publication by manifest path
|   |-- Optional expected token is JSON.stringify(manifest)
|   |-- Reuse unchanged refs; prune docs absent from new summary
|   `-- Merge supplied receipts; unchanged DiffTree summary permits reuse
|-- [D] Restored DiffTree must match summary and session hunk context
|   |-- Every hunk belongs to session repository
|   |-- Explicit comparisonBase: hunk.commit=head and hunk.parent=base
|   `-- Otherwise hunk.commit must be among selected commits
|-- [O] Preview and validated-document caches key by immutable reference
|   `-- Each caps at 16 entries; oldest insertion evicted; return clones
`-- [C] Legacy summary uses file-generation stamp; handle closes in finally
    `-- Manifest demand splits legacy records without restoring all histories
